note: FUNCTIONAL means the cited tests pass for the documented scope. Only VERIFIED_PARITY is treated as behavioral parity for that capability. This manifest is not an application-completeness claim.

capabilities.name: Classic coordinate entry
capabilities.reference_behavior: Absolute Cartesian coordinates are x,y. @dx,dy and @dist<angle are relative to LASTPOINT. dist<angle is polar from the origin. # forces absolute. Angles are degrees counterclockwise from +X. A relative coordinate with no previous point is rejected.
capabilities.expected_output: First segment (0,0)-(10,0). Second segment (10,5)-(10,15).
capabilities.performance: Parsing is proportional to the token length.
capabilities.differences: No UCS, dynamic-input tooltip, or polar tracking. 3D x,y,z is rejected. Ortho applies to interactive points after the coordinate is resolved.

capabilities.name: Line
capabilities.reference_behavior: Two points create one line segment. The command can be completed on one line or by subsequent point input. Undo removes the segment.
capabilities.expected_output: One LINE entity from the first point to the second.
capabilities.performance: Constant time per segment.
capabilities.differences: Continue, Close, Undo-within-command, and 3D lines are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Circle
capabilities.reference_behavior: Center plus radius, or center plus a point on the circumference. Non-positive radius is rejected.
capabilities.expected_output: One CIRCLE of radius 3.
capabilities.performance: Constant time.
capabilities.differences: 2P, 3P, and TTR circle options are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Polyline
capabilities.reference_behavior: Vertices accumulate until END or close. A closed polyline stores one entity.
capabilities.expected_input: PLINE points then END or C
capabilities.expected_output: One POLYLINE entity.
capabilities.performance: Linear in vertex count.
capabilities.differences: No arc segments, width, or linetype generation.

capabilities.name: Rectangle
capabilities.reference_behavior: Two corners create a closed four-vertex polyline.
capabilities.expected_output: One closed POLYLINE.
capabilities.performance: Constant time.
capabilities.differences: No chamfer, fillet, rotation, or elevation options on RECTANG.

capabilities.name: Move, copy, rotate, scale
capabilities.reference_behavior: Transforms the current selection about the supplied base point. Copy creates new entities. Undo restores the previous geometry.
capabilities.expected_input: Selection plus two points or a numeric angle/factor
capabilities.expected_output: Moved, copied, rotated, or scaled entities.
capabilities.performance: Linear in the number of selected entities.
capabilities.differences: No reference-scale option, multiple copy, or grip editing.

capabilities.name: Trim, extend, offset, fillet, chamfer
capabilities.reference_behavior: Trim and extend adjust lines at a pick. Offset creates a parallel entity. Fillet and chamfer operate on two lines.
capabilities.expected_input: Selected geometry plus a pick, distance, radius, or chamfer distances
capabilities.expected_output: Modified or additional line and arc geometry.
capabilities.performance: Linear in candidate edges for each pick.
capabilities.differences: Polyline trim is limited. Fillet and chamfer do not yet cover polylines. No fence or edge mode.

capabilities.name: Window and crossing selection
capabilities.reference_behavior: Left-to-right selects entities fully inside the rectangle. Right-to-left selects entities that intersect it.
capabilities.expected_input: Two rectangle corners and a crossing flag
capabilities.expected_output: Selection set matches containment or intersection.
capabilities.performance: Linear in entity count.
capabilities.differences: No lasso, fence, polygon window, or selection filters. Frozen, off, and locked layers are excluded.

capabilities.name: Layer create, current, on, off, lock, color
capabilities.reference_behavior: NEW creates a layer. MAKE and SET choose the current layer. OFF hides entities and blocks selection. LOCK blocks selection. COLOR sets the layer color. The current layer cannot be turned off.
capabilities.expected_input: LAYER NEW Walls; LAYER OFF Doors; LAYER COLOR Doors FF0000
capabilities.expected_output: Layer table updated. Hidden and locked entities are not hit-tested.
capabilities.performance: Linear in layer count for name lookup.
capabilities.differences: No layer states, filters, description, transparency, viewport overrides, or full layer-manager dialog.

capabilities.name: Layer freeze and thaw
capabilities.reference_behavior: Freeze hides a layer independently of On/Off. The current layer cannot be frozen. Thaw does not turn an off layer on. Frozen entities are not drawn or selected. Flags persist in the native file.
capabilities.expected_input: LAYER FREEZE Walls while layer 0 is current
capabilities.expected_output: Walls.frozen is true and its entities fail hit testing until THAW.
capabilities.performance: Visibility checks are constant time per entity.
capabilities.differences: No viewport freeze, new-VP freeze, or regen distinction between Off and Frozen.

capabilities.name: Layer plot flag
capabilities.reference_behavior: Plot and No Plot change whether a layer is marked for plotting without hiding it in model space. The flag round-trips in the native file.
capabilities.expected_output: plottable is false and the entity remains selectable.
capabilities.performance: Constant time per layer.
capabilities.differences: No plotter consumes the flag yet. Plot styles, page setups, and PDF output are separate unimplemented capabilities.

capabilities.name: Change color and layer
capabilities.reference_behavior: Sets selection color to a hex value or ByLayer, or moves the selection to a named layer.
capabilities.expected_input: CHPROP COLOR FF0000 or CHPROP LAYER name
capabilities.expected_output: Entity color or layer id changes and undo restores it.
capabilities.performance: Linear in selection size.
capabilities.differences: No linetype, lineweight, transparency, or thickness properties.

capabilities.name: Aligned linear dimension
capabilities.reference_behavior: Three points define the two extension origins and the dimension-line location. Measurement is the distance between origins.
capabilities.expected_output: One dimension entity whose measurement equals the origin distance.
capabilities.performance: Constant time.
capabilities.differences: Horizontal, vertical, rotated, angular, radius, and diameter dimensions are not implemented. No DIMSTYLE or associativity. DXF export omits dimensions.

capabilities.name: Endpoint, midpoint, center, intersection, perpendicular snaps
capabilities.reference_behavior: When enabled, a pick near a qualifying geometry point resolves to that snap.
capabilities.expected_input: OSNAP END|MID|CEN|INT|PER and a cursor position
capabilities.expected_output: The snapped point matches the geometric feature within tolerance.
capabilities.performance: Linear in nearby candidate geometry.
capabilities.differences: No tangent, quadrant, nearest, node, insertion, apparent intersection, or object-snap tracking.

capabilities.name: Block definition and insert
capabilities.reference_behavior: BLOCK defines a named block from the selection relative to a base point and replaces the selection with an insert. INSERT places another reference with scale and rotation. The definition round-trips in the native file.
capabilities.expected_output: One block definition and insert entities.
capabilities.performance: Linear in the number of selected primitives.
capabilities.differences: No attributes, dynamic blocks, nested inserts inside a definition, or uniform/non-uniform separate XY scales. DXF does not write blocks.

capabilities.name: Explode insert or polyline
capabilities.reference_behavior: An insert is replaced by its block primitives transformed by insertion, scale, and rotation. A polyline is replaced by one line per segment, including the closing segment. The block definition remains. Undo restores the original object. Lines, circles, and other non-explodable entities are left unchanged.
capabilities.expected_input: EXPLODE on a scaled rotated insert, or on a closed rectangle
capabilities.expected_output: Transformed primitives or four rectangle edges. One undo restores the insert.
capabilities.performance: Linear in primitive or segment count.
capabilities.differences: Does not explode dimensions, hatches, or multiline text. Non-uniform XY scale is not represented. Nested inserts inside definitions are not stored.

capabilities.name: Single-line text
capabilities.reference_behavior: A point, height, and string create one text entity.
capabilities.expected_output: Text contents and height match the input.
capabilities.performance: Constant time.
capabilities.differences: No style, justification, multiline text, or DXF text round-trip.

capabilities.name: Solid hatch from closed polyline
capabilities.reference_behavior: A selected closed polyline produces a solid fill using that boundary.
capabilities.expected_input: HATCH with a closed polyline selected
capabilities.expected_output: One HATCH entity.
capabilities.performance: Linear in boundary vertices.
capabilities.differences: No pattern hatches, gradients, islands, associativity, or separate boundary selection.

capabilities.name: Native drawing round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: The native JSON drawing reloads tested entities and layer flags.
capabilities.expected_output: Geometry and recorded layer flags match.
capabilities.performance: Linear in entity count.
capabilities.differences: Schema 4. This is MyDesk's editable format, not DWG. Text and hatch serialization remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Basic DXF round-trip
capabilities.reference_behavior: LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, LWPOLYLINE, and LAYER survive a DXF write and read for the tested fixture.
capabilities.expected_output: The same entity kinds and coordinates reload.
capabilities.performance: Linear in entity count.
capabilities.differences: Dimensions, blocks, text, hatches, xrefs, and most tables are omitted and reported.

capabilities.name: Undo and redo
capabilities.reference_behavior: Entity transactions undo and redo in order.
capabilities.expected_output: The entity disappears and returns.
capabilities.performance: Linear in operations stored in the transaction.
capabilities.differences: Layer property changes are not transactions. No UNDO mark, group, or command-history browser.

capabilities.name: Linetypes
capabilities.reference_behavior: Layers and entities store named linetypes Continuous, Dashed, Hidden, Center, Phantom, Dot. ByLayer resolves to the layer. LTSCALE scales the pattern. Patterns round-trip in native and DXF layer/entity group 6.
capabilities.expected_input: LAYER LTYPE Hidden DASHED; CHPROP LTYPE CENTER; LTSCALE 2
capabilities.expected_output: Resolved entity linetype is Center; native and DXF reload preserve layer Dashed and entity Center.
capabilities.performance: Dash tessellation is proportional to visible edge length.
capabilities.differences: No custom .lin file loading, complex shape dashes, or ISO pen tables. Display uses Qt dash patterns scaled by LTSCALE.

capabilities.name: Lineweights
capabilities.reference_behavior: Layers and entities store millimeter lineweights 0–2.11. ByLayer resolves to the layer. Native persistence round-trips the values. Display scales stroke width from millimeters.
capabilities.expected_output: Resolved weight is 0.70 until ByLayer restores 0.50.
capabilities.performance: Constant time per entity.
capabilities.differences: No DXF group 370 round-trip yet. No plot-style mapping. Display mapping is approximate screen pixels, not calibrated plot millimeters.

capabilities.name: Block attributes
capabilities.reference_behavior: Attribute definitions in a block become editable tags on each insert.
capabilities.expected_input: Define a tag and insert the block
capabilities.expected_output: Each insert stores its own attribute values.
capabilities.performance: Linear in attribute count per insert.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: External references
capabilities.reference_behavior: A drawing references another drawing without copying its definition. Reload and detach update the host.
capabilities.expected_input: Attach a second drawing and move it
capabilities.expected_output: The host stores the reference path and transform, not a flattened copy.
capabilities.performance: Must not load unused reference geometry into the host command set.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: Layouts, paper space, and viewports
capabilities.reference_behavior: A drawing has model space plus named paper-space layouts with scaled viewports.
capabilities.expected_input: Create a layout and a viewport looking at model geometry
capabilities.expected_output: Paper-space coordinates and viewport scale are stored separately from model geometry.
capabilities.performance: Switching layouts must not duplicate model entities.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented. Draft edits a single model space.

capabilities.name: Plot and PDF output
capabilities.reference_behavior: A page setup plots selected layouts to PDF with scale, plot style, and the layer plot flag.
capabilities.expected_input: Plot the model or a layout to PDF
capabilities.expected_output: A vector PDF containing the plotted geometry.
capabilities.performance: A multi-sheet technical drawing plots without flattening to a bitmap.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: DWG interoperability
capabilities.reference_behavior: Open and save DWG drawings with geometry, layers, and supported objects preserved or explicitly reported.
capabilities.expected_output: Round-trip evidence for the supported subset, with unsupported objects reported.
capabilities.performance: Large drawings stay within interactive memory limits.
capabilities.differences: Unsupported. No DWG claim is allowed until a lawful reader and round-trip tests exist. See docs/DECISIONS/0004-dwg-strategy.md.

capabilities.name: Layer states
capabilities.reference_behavior: Named snapshots restore visibility, freeze, lock, color, and plot flags.
capabilities.expected_input: Save a state, change layers, restore the state
capabilities.expected_output: Layer flags match the snapshot.
capabilities.performance: Restore is linear in layer count.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: User coordinate systems
capabilities.reference_behavior: Named coordinate systems change how typed coordinates and angles are interpreted.
capabilities.expected_input: UCS origin and X axis, then a typed point
capabilities.expected_output: The stored world point matches the UCS transform.
capabilities.performance: Coordinate transforms are constant time.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented. Coordinates are world-space only.

capabilities.name: Dynamic input
capabilities.reference_behavior: Dimensions and coordinate fields follow the cursor during a command and accept the same coordinate syntax.
capabilities.expected_input: Start LINE and type a length in the dynamic field
capabilities.expected_output: The segment uses that length.
capabilities.performance: The field updates every pointer move without blocking input.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented. Typed coordinates work on the command line.

capabilities.name: Polar tracking
capabilities.reference_behavior: Cursor movement locks to configured angle increments while a command is active.
capabilities.expected_input: Polar angle 45 degrees and a point near that ray
capabilities.expected_output: The accepted point lies on the tracked ray.
capabilities.performance: Tracking is constant time per pointer move.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented. Ortho (F8) is the only directional constraint.

capabilities.name: Mirror and stretch
capabilities.reference_behavior: Mirror reflects geometry across two points. Stretch moves vertices inside a crossing window.
capabilities.expected_input: A crossing window and a displacement, or a mirror axis
capabilities.expected_output: Only the indicated vertices move, or a reflected copy is created.
capabilities.performance: Linear in selected vertices.
capabilities.differences: Commands are recognized and rejected as not implemented.

capabilities.name: Arrays
capabilities.reference_behavior: Rectangular, polar, and path arrays create associated copies.
capabilities.expected_output: The requested copies exist and an associative array can be edited.
capabilities.performance: Creation is linear in copy count.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: Geometric and dimensional constraints
capabilities.reference_behavior: Constraints solve when a driving dimension changes.
capabilities.expected_input: A coincident constraint and a driving distance
capabilities.expected_output: Dependent geometry moves to satisfy the constraint.
capabilities.performance: Solve time stays interactive for typical sketch sizes.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: Multiline text, leaders, tables, and dimension styles
capabilities.reference_behavior: Formatted text, leaders, tables, and named dimension styles are editable objects.
capabilities.expected_input: Create each object and reload the drawing
capabilities.expected_output: Content, placement, and style survive save.
capabilities.performance: Editing one text object does not redraw the entire drawing from scratch beyond the damaged region.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented. Single-line text and one aligned dimension exist as separate capabilities.

capabilities.name: Spline, ellipse, and arc command
capabilities.reference_behavior: ARC, ELLIPSE, and SPLINE create their own editable geometry.
capabilities.expected_input: ARC center-start-end, ELLIPSE axes, SPLINE fit points
capabilities.expected_output: The stored curve passes through the specified points within tolerance.
capabilities.performance: Evaluation is proportional to the displayed tessellation.
capabilities.differences: Arc entities can be created by fillet. The ARC command itself is not implemented.

capabilities.name: Autosave, audit, purge, and recovery
capabilities.reference_behavior: Autosave can restore a crashed drawing. Audit reports corruption. Purge removes unused named objects without deleting referenced ones.
capabilities.expected_input: A drawing with an unused layer and a simulated crash journal
capabilities.expected_output: Purge removes only the unused name. Recovery reloads the journal.
capabilities.performance: Audit scans the file once.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.name: AutoLISP-compatible automation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Command scripts and an AutoLISP-compatible subset can create and query drawing entities.
capabilities.expected_input: A script that draws a line and reads its endpoints
capabilities.expected_output: The same geometry the interactive command would create.
capabilities.performance: Script playback is not slower than the equivalent interactive commands by more than a small constant factor.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented. No ObjectARX or binary plugin compatibility is claimed.

capabilities.name: Layer filters
capabilities.reference_behavior: Named filters show subsets of the layer list.
capabilities.expected_output: Filtered list shows matching layers
capabilities.performance: Must remain interactive on professional drawings.
capabilities.differences: Not implemented.

capabilities.performance: Must remain interactive on professional drawings.
